story.paragraph1: Tank Q Solution was founded on the belief that customers deserve more than just a "cheap tank" — they deserve the "right tank" for their specific application.
story.paragraph2: We started as engineers with real factory experience, knowing what wrong resin or improper lamination costs. We promised ourselves never to let that happen to our customers.
story.paragraph3: Today, we deliver FRP tanks to 500+ factories nationwide across 50+ industries, maintaining the same quality on every unit.
